  6. Initialize a variable ans with the value "No".

fix_code:
def main():
    n, m = map(int, input().split())
    a = list(map(int, input().split()))
    b = list(map(int, input().split()))

    c = [(i, 0) for i in a] + [(i, 1) for i in b]
    c.sort()

    ans = "No"
    for i in range(n + m - 1):
        if c[i][1] == 0 and c[i + 1][1] == 0:
            ans = "Yes"
            break

    print(ans)
